thread:
Alex: Quick heads-up — I want to lock the version bump for v2.4.0. Target cutoff is Thu 18:00 UTC. Please land any bugfix/backport PRs before then. We need a full CI green sweep on main and release/v2.4 branches.

Mira: Noted. There's a flaky in integration/test-redis that failed twice on the CI run. Samir, can you take a look? :eyes:

Samir: I'm on it. Reproduced `TestRedisReconnect` locally with `-race`. Looks like teardown ordering. I'll draft a fix and run the suite.

Jen: Changelog reminder — add entries under Unreleased -> v2.4.0. If people drop PR links I can assemble a draft changelog. :memo:

CI-Bot: build #4321 — 3 failing tests: integration/test-redis, e2e/login_flow, unit/parser_serde. Rerun requested by @Alex.

Alex: Kicked a rerun for the pipeline. @ReleaseCoordinator can you confirm final cutoff policy? Are doc-only patches allowed after cutoff?

ReleaseCoordinator: Cutoff is locked at 2024-05-30T18:00:00Z. Small docs-only fixes are OK post-cutoff but require approval from the owning PM and a quick sanity CI job.

Mira: Samir posted a draft PR for the redis teardown tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/789 — needs review.

Samir: Fixed the teardown race and added an extra assertion, pushed. Running the full suite locally now.

Jen: Also tagging Product/design: the changelog needs a tiny console screenshot for the new dashboard change. @Design would you be able to produce that?

Design: Will do a small cropped screenshot and post in the docs PR. ETA ~30m.

Alex: Plan once CI is all green: open the version-bump PR that updates VERSION + CHANGELOG, leave it as draft until changelog compiles. I'll do the final tag after we merge. Reminder for the steps I run locally: 
```
git checkout -b release/v2.4.0
# bump VERSION
./scripts/compile-changelog --from v2.3.9 --to v2.4.0 > CHANGELOG.md
git commit -am "chore(release): v2.4.0"
gh pr create --base main --fill
```

Any blockers right now?

CI-Bot: Rerun complete: all jobs green except e2e/login_flow which failed again (timing). @Samir queued a rerun for the flaky test group.

Samir: e2e login failure looks like an auth redirect timing window on CI nodes. Adding a short wait in the harness, will PR that fix shortly.

Mira: If teams have backports to request for the release branch, ping here with the PR link and owner. We'll triage tomorrow morning during the pre-cutoff sweep.

Alex: Thanks all. I'll post a 30m-before cutoff check-in with final list. :tada:

Jen: One more note — please make sure to label changelog entries with component tags (runtime, console, infra) so I can group them automatically.

Design: Screenshot uploaded to PR comment.

Samir: Submitted PR for e2e wait tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/794 — re-run queued.

CI-Bot: Rerun #4335 — full suite green. All required checks passed.

Alex: Excellent. Closing this thread for now — reopening if anything pops up before cutoff.
